_meta.finding: NO public no-auth JSON endpoint exists for *.icims.com portals. danielhagever/job-board-apis (verified 2026-10-25, weekly re-verified) lists iCIMS under 'Systems with no JSON endpoint': '{name}.icims.com/jobs/search?ss=1&in_iframe=1, a server-rendered list'. Multiple independent sources agree (dev.to 2026-07-10: 'Taleo, Oracle Cloud, Phenom and iCIMS dominate enterprise, and none of them publish an open job API'). The authenticated Platform API (api.icims.com/customers/{customerId}/search/portals/...) needs per-customer Basic/OAuth credentials and is NOT usable. Jibe (iCIMS-owned) DOES have GET {careers-host}/api/jobs?page=1&limit=100 — but only on employer-owned careers hosts (e.g. careers.costco.com), NOT on *.icims.com portals; do not call /api/jobs on an icims host without a live test first.
_meta.note: iCIMS classic career portals have NO public JSON API (see _meta.finding). This file is the raw material the fetcher will parse instead: server-rendered HTML list pages + one HTML detail page per job. Descriptions below are plain text transcribed from the text-fetch crawl of the live detail pages on 2026-11-19 (crawler copies, crawled <1 min before reading); nothing essential trimmed. The crawl truncates the repeated 'Additional Details / Description:' field, so description = the visible posting body, which is the full posting.

jobs.description: Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can't be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer with hands-on experience across the full Systems Engineering and Integration Lifecycle, including architecture, requirements development, CONOPS, systems integration, testing, and transition to operations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the GEOINT Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation, and Dissemination (TCPED) Architecture, along with experience supporting NGA and/or its GEOINT Mission Partners. As a member of the Enterprise Engineering & Architecture Division's Integration Team, you will support enterprise transformation initiatives across GEOINT mission systems and projects. You will apply systems engineering expertise, critical thinking, and strategic technical planning to drive architecture modernization, evaluate enterprise capabilities, and advance GEOINT mission objectives. Working alongside Expert, Mid, and Junior Engineers and Integrators, you will conduct enterprise-level engineering analyses, develop strategic recommendations, and support investment decisions, including system divestitures and consolidation. You will collaborate across NGA Program Executive Offices (PEOs) and Mission Partners to synchronize integration activities, maintain the enterprise baseline for architectures, requirements, and interfaces, and facilitate the transition of capabilities into operations. Within NGA's Digital Engineering Environment, you will help develop integrated project plans, requirements, epics, target-state architectures, CONOPS, and roadmaps. You will also participate in cross-organizational Integrated Project Teams supporting modernization initiatives across Analytic, Collection Management, Data Services, Foundation GEOINT, and Information Technology. What You'll Do: In partnership with Systems Engineering, Integration, and Architecture teammates, you will: Perform architecture gap analyses and develop future-state enterprise architectures. Conduct engineering analyses to inform GEOINT mission and IT capability investment decisions, ensuring alignment with the established Enterprise Architecture baseline. Analyze and maintain enterprise baselines, including the allocation of requirements to system architecture components and end-to-end traceability across requirements, architectures, and executing programs. Translate mission objectives and customer needs into actionable system and capability requirements and technical solutions. Lead and participate in cross-organizational systems integration activities and Integrated Project Teams (IPTs), coordinating project plans, architecture and engineering artifacts (including CONOPS), roadmaps, schedules, and risk management activities. Define integration and interface requirements to support interoperability and coordinated campaign planning. Lead and participate in Analyses of Alternatives (AoAs), Courses of Action (CoAs), trade studies, and decision assessments. Provide technical thought leadership by identifying opportunities to expand team scope and developing project plans that define tasking, deliverables, and execution timelines. Participate in NGA governance, configuration management, and risk management processes. Help modernize systems engineering and integration processes by advancing the adoption of automation, artificial intelligence, and digital engineering practices to improve efficiencies and strengthen collaboration across multiple organizations. Location: This position is fully onsite in Chantilly, VA. Qualifications - Required: 12+ years of experience and a Bachelor's degree or higher in Systems Engineering or a related technical or scientific discipline, such as Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Management Information Systems; or 12+ years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Senior-level experience in government or industry supporting relevant areas, including DoD/IC acquisition processes, requirements processes, Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBES), or systems engineering of large, complex Systems of Systems (SoS) or Service-Oriented Architecture/Cloud environments. Strong understanding and experience across the systems engineering lifecycle. TS/SCI clearance adjudication or the ability to obtain SCI and successfully pass a polygraph. Desired: Extensive experience or working knowledge of the GEOINT TCPED Architecture, including data providers, systems and services, interfaces, and data flows. Demonstrated knowledge of the current National System for Geospatial Intelligence (NSG), Allied System for Geospatial Intelligence (ASG), and NRO enterprises. Experience leading high-priority, complex, large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives spanning multiple organizations. Strong customer-facing and communication skills, including experience briefing senior leadership at agency-level boards and forums. Knowledge of transformational technology initiatives, including Artificial Intelligence, multi-cloud environments, and/or edge nodes. Experience with agile project management tools, such as Jira and Confluence. Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certification(s). Experience or working knowledge of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including associated processes, tools, and languages. $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own. EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Prepare and distribute course announcements, materials, and pre-course communications. Track and report training metrics, completion rates, and seat usage. Monitor required staff training (e.g., annual security, counterintelligence, and insider threat refreshers). Collect and compile learner feedback and evaluation data to support course improvement. Position Overview: Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group is seeking a Board-Certified Primary Care Physician (Internal Medicine or Family Medicine) to join our established outpatient practice in Plainfield, Illinois, affiliated with Saint Joseph Medical Center in Joliet, Illinois. This is a full-time, employed position focused on providing high-quality, patient-centered care to a diverse patient population in a collaborative and supportive environment. About Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group: Part of the nationally recognized Prime Healthcare network, our medical group is committed to delivering personalized and evidence-based care to patients across Illinois. We prioritize clinical excellence, patient satisfaction, and provider well-being. Specialties Accepted: Internal Medicine or Family Medicine. Setting: 100% outpatient. Schedule: Monday-Friday, daytime hours. No inpatient or hospital call responsibilities. Average patient load: Manageable volume to ensure quality care. Support staff: Experienced clinical and administrative team. Electronic Medical Record (EMR): Epic. Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. A reasonable compensation estimate for this role, which includes estimated wages, benefits, and other forms of compensation, is $275,000- $300,000. on an annualized basis. The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire, in which a wide range of factors will be considered, including but not limited to, skillset, years of applicable experience, education, credentials and licensure. The company is dedicated to empowering its staff with a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, allowing them the freedom to customize their benefits to fit their unique needs. Our abundant resources, programs, and voluntary options serve as a foundation for individual growth and well-being.
